stripping_order: direct descendants of same classical definition

transforms.reason: Independent calibration instances, same weakest relative-cycle operational statement after angular-unit stripping.
Calculated diameters are derived readouts of already measured C/A/V plus a shared classical definition.
Pure transform reconstruction is a convention control; physical spectral comparison survives only invariantly after consistent conversion.
Gaussian model normalization is not independent physics; diffusion/relaxation remains empirical.

constraints.operational_statement: Command a finite sequence intended to exhaust one repeatable mechanical cycle and measure whether the final apparatus state returns to the reference state within a stated closure error; retain the interval-error pattern over repeated runs.
constraints.required_observable_protocol: Finite indexing sequence plus independent comparator/reference check at each indexed state and at cycle closure.
constraints.scale_range: One or many full mechanical turns at the indexing-table scale covered by the calibration apparatus.
constraints.tolerance: Use the measured indexing/closure uncertainty of the declared calibration; no universal angular unit or π-valued tolerance is imposed.

constraints.operational_statement: Sample a closed manufactured profile repeatedly under controlled reindexing and require reproducible boundary data plus separability of apparatus-correlated and workpiece-correlated deviations.
constraints.required_observable_protocol: Multiple full-profile traces with the artifact deliberately reindexed between traces; compare correlated components.
constraints.scale_range: Precision manufactured nominally round components over the instrument's dimensional range.
constraints.tolerance: Use profile-sampling and repeatability uncertainty declared by the instrument/protocol.

constraints.operational_statement: Under controlled wrap path, tension and thermal state, a calibrated length device produces repeatable closed-wrap length indications around the manufactured artifact.
constraints.required_observable_protocol: Traceable length calibration plus controlled wrap/tension/temperature procedure repeated on the same artifact.
constraints.tolerance: Use the PI-tape/length calibration uncertainty and repeatability reported for the declared instrument/procedure.

constraints.operational_statement: From many independently localized boundary samples with a traceable scale, compute an enclosed-area readout that is stable under repetition and instrument comparison within the stated uncertainty.
constraints.required_observable_protocol: Calibrated translation/imaging of boundary points followed by discrete enclosed-area computation; do not substitute an ideal circular area formula for the measured boundary.
constraints.scale_range: Millimetre-to-centimetre aperture scales in the cited NIST systems.
constraints.tolerance: Roughly 10^-5 to 10^-4 relative for cited high-accuracy aperture systems, with exact value conditioned on size/instrument.

constraints.operational_statement: Compose an independently calibrated transverse measure with controlled displacement to predict displaced quantity, then divide by elapsed time to predict flow; observed transfer agrees within the stated calibration envelope.
constraints.required_observable_protocol: Independent area/transverse-measure calibration, piston displacement metrology, elapsed-time metrology, and output flow comparison.
constraints.scale_range: Approximately 0.003-2.0 L/s over the two cited NIST piston-prover ranges.
constraints.tolerance: Approximately 0.044% and 0.064% expanded relative uncertainty for the two cited provers.

constraints.operational_statement: Realize transferred/contained quantity independently from mass and density under controlled thermal/transfer conditions and require agreement with the capacity readout across scale within the stated uncertainty.
constraints.required_observable_protocol: Gravimetric water transfer with mass, density/temperature and transfer corrections; compare realized and reported capacity.
constraints.scale_range: Approximately 3.8 L to 7600 L in the cited NIST service.
constraints.tolerance: Expanded relative uncertainty roughly 0.015% at the largest cited standards to about 0.33% at the smallest, depending service point.

constraints.operational_statement: For two repeatable periodic channels, measured relative time/fraction-of-cycle displacement is reproducible, and its change across epochs/frequency settings predicts relative drift without choosing radians as the physical observable.
constraints.required_observable_protocol: Two-channel time/phase comparison using zero crossings or equivalent phase comparator, reported primarily as time displacement or cycle fraction; repeat across frequency/settings.
constraints.scale_range: Precision time/frequency and low-frequency electrical phase calibration; cited NIST phase systems span approximately 1 Hz-100 kHz depending system.
constraints.tolerance: Use service-specific time/phase uncertainty; no universal radian tolerance is imposed.

constraints.operational_statement: Under a declared, internally consistent spectral convention, finite sampled channels can be transformed/reconstructed and a band-limited cross-spectral noise/reference comparison remains stable under convention changes after the Jacobian/scale conversion is applied.
constraints.required_observable_protocol: Acquire time-series samples, compute cross spectra with a declared transform/PSD convention, integrate/compare over the same physical bandwidth, and verify that the physical ratio/energy statement is invariant after convention conversion.
constraints.scale_range: Finite digital transforms and NIST wide-band noise thermometry over the declared sample rate/bandwidth.
constraints.tolerance: Numerical roundoff for transform inversion plus system-specific thermometry/spectral uncertainty for the physical comparison.

constraints.operational_statement: A controlled localized thermal perturbation exhibits reproducible relaxation/spread whose characteristic time and scale depend on specimen/material state; any probability/Green-function amplitude used to represent it must be normalized consistently, but the Gaussian π factor is not itself an observed constraint.
constraints.required_observable_protocol: Prepare specimen and boundary/initial state, apply a localized thermal pulse, measure transient response, repeat/compare characteristic times or fitted diffusivity; separately verify uncertainty-model adequacy.
constraints.scale_range: Laboratory solid/powder laser-flash regimes in the cited NIST work; continuum model valid only where experimentally supported.
constraints.tolerance: Experiment/material-specific thermal-diffusivity uncertainty plus declared measurement uncertainty model; no Gaussian-normalization tolerance.
stripped_dependencies: choice of normal vs rectangular/triangular uncertainty model

constraints.operational_statement: A bounded propagation apparatus exhibits discrete repeatable resonances; their frequencies and shifts co-vary with controlled cavity/material state, and independent acoustic and microwave channels can cross-check the same apparatus state within uncertainty.
constraints.required_observable_protocol: Excite identified bounded modes, measure resonance frequencies repeatedly, independently measure/track cavity state, perturb temperature/material conditions, and compare acoustic and microwave channels.
constraints.scale_range: Precision laboratory acoustic/microwave resonators over the temperature/dimension regimes reported in cited NIST work.
constraints.tolerance: Cited acoustic resonance-frequency relative uncertainties range from roughly 0.2×10^-6 to several ×10^-6 depending system and temperature.
stripped_dependencies: Euclidean cavity geometry as native premise
continuum wave equation as native ontology
